verdict.rationale: Mercury claims native sync with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite, plus AI automations to close books faster. Its API offers real-time webhooks on transactions, editable categories and transaction metadata, which could support a custom integration. However, nothing shows the native ERP sync is real-time or bidirectional, and there is no detail on how it replaces manual journal entries. Missing for 10: documented real-time ERP sync, evidence of bidirectional data flow (ERP-to-Mercury write-back), sync scope and mapping details for journal entries, independent or hands-on corroboration of the accounting integrations.
